notes.title: Update there I've fixed several bugs and made few balance changes)
notes.content:
[h2]Update for Laboratory X-29 is here![/h2]

[h3][u][b]I've fixed several nasty bugs)[/b][/u][/h3]

[list] 
[*] [b]First of all[/b] - I've fixed issues with [b][u]"the Last room"[/u][/b] where you'd get stuck there with no way out but to restart the game. 
[*] [i][b][u]"Rat King"[/u][/b][/i] second ability now aiming properly then shooting small rats into you.
[*] [b][u]Sound and music [/u][/b]now don't begin to mix and play over each other after runs ends successfully.
[*] [b][u][i]"Top secret"[/i][/u][/b] lore note now appear and work properly.
[*] [b][u]Companions[/u][/b] now don't distract "the Last room" cutscene with there effects.
[*] Fixed: small visual issues with some effects/abilities.
[/list]
[u][b]Make sure you tell me about issues you found so I could fix them)[/b][/u]

[u][h3]Also I've made few balance changes:[/h3][/u]
[list] 
[*] [b][u]"[i]Chicky[/i]"[/u][/b] was too good with eating chicken for you. So, now he will eat chicken and heal you every [b][u]13 seconds[/u][/b] instead of previously [u][i]11 seconds[/i]. [/u]

[*] [b][u]"[i]Fafnir[/i]"[/u][/b] now deal more damage by attack. From previous [u][i]5/5x2/8x2[/i][/u] to [b][u]7/7x2/10x2[/u][/b] in each form respectively.

[*] [b][u]"[i]R3D3[/i]"[/u][/b] lore note bonus ability now triggers every [b][u]25 seconds[/u][/b] instead of previous [u][i]30 seconds.[/i][/u] Also, now you need [b][u]25 energy[/u][/b] instead of [u][i]35 energy[/i] [/u]collected to trigger bonus ability.
[b]Note:[/b] [i]Hope this companions changes help you to give a try to every companion on your runs)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296117/771317ddbd87628e791f3fa1a354ff7562ede2fe.gif[/img]

[*] [b][u]"[i]GM's Dice set[/i]"[/u][/b] is too good) I don't want to nerf it and take away fun) So I tried to buff most underperforming weapon in a list. And sadly for me it's [b][u]"[i]Sawed-off[/i]"[/u][/b]. Sadly - because I think this is the most powerful weapon if you need a fast way to deal with enemies one by one. So, now bonus from [b][u]"[i]Sawed-off[/i]"[/u][/b] lore note will transform [u][b]every bullet into "charged" one[/b][/u] and [u][i]not by chance.[/i][/u]
[b]Note:[/b] [i]I still think that fun is more important than nerfing things. So, if you think that you favorite weapon or lore note bonus/ability feel a bit "meh" - tell me and we will try to find solution for that)[/i]

[*] I hear that [b][u]"[i]Laser Rooms[/i]"[/u][/b] cause too many troubles. This room was indented to be high danger and deadly encounter. But I understand that it's may be not fun. So, now this room [b][u]will have less lasers and a bit more space to maneuver. [/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296117/8d64016ee90d107b2c63f392f937d9a83e8fc59b.gif[/img]

[*] [b][u]"[i]Petey[/i]"[/u] [/b]from level 3 of Laboratory will return with cool new ability already with next update. 
[u]Stay tuned)[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296117/a1a798bed1c550283f82b514b681e56c0f977d7a.gif[/img]
[/list]


[b]Good luck![/b]

[h3](\ /) 0_o (\ /)[/h3]

notes.title: Small Update for Laboratory X-29 is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Small update for Laboratory X-29 is out![/h3]

I've added few Quality of life changes (like added permanent "E"-button animation on top of weapon creator and lore notes panels)

[u][b]Make sure you interact with them every time you see them)[/b][/u]

[h3]Also I made few changes to the difficulty:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]"[i]Mr. Crabs[/i]" and "[i]Wanna be Devil[/i]"[/u][/b], you can encounter on level 1 of Laboratory, now have about [b]30% LESS health[/b]. This changes must help new players get into the game easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296117/e267d12fadee09e2891b201e321cd630d00fee2b.gif[/img]

[*] [b][u]"[i]Kraken's[/i]"[/u][/b] ability - "[b]Lightning Strike[/b]" now have new animation. With this change you now have more time to react on this attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296117/3b5190e1078c3ce106637c66f2bf41d4857b02dd.gif[/img]

[*] [b][u]"[i]Petey[/i]"[/u] [/b]from level 3 of Laboratory, going on ability rework. His old ability was too problematic and may cause some weird interactions with player and "Petey's" bullet was not visible enough. 
[u]But don't worry - he will return soon with cool new ability)[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296117/a1a798bed1c550283f82b514b681e56c0f977d7a.gif[/img]
[/list]


[b]Good luck![/b]

[h3](\ /) 0_o (\ /)[/h3]

notes.title: Small difficulty update
notes.content:
After a few days of demo availability, I decided to lower the difficulty a bit. 

[list]
[b][*] The first few rooms will be easier for the player.
[*] The enemies will have slightly less health. But that doesn't mean it's easier. 
[*] The monsters will be less damage sponges, but some will be more dangerous. [/b]
[/list]
I hope you will continue to give me feedback and help me improve the game.

Thank you very much!

[b](\/) 0_о (\/)[/b]

Fight your way through rooms filled with dangerous experiments! 
Find lore notes from the scientists that reveal the truth about what's going on.
Eat fried chicken to survive in this creepy place. 
Also remember: every time you eat chicken to restore your health everything can happen:

- Your gun turn into chicken? - [i]Yes.[/i]

- Your clone appeared and shot enemies? - [i]Yes![/i]

- Your screen goes upside down? - A[i]lso YES![/i]

Don't forget to leave a review )
